title: 3'-DGE High Throughput RNA Library Preparation
author: Sarah Boswell
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bumynu7w
materials: Set up reagents and plates on BRAVO as follows:

Bring reagents for RT: Repeater & 2x 1 mL tips 2x Eppendorf Twintec PCR plates 2.25x BRAVO tip boxes for reaction Set of standard pipettes & Filter tips 5x RT Buffer 850 µl dNTPs (NEB - #N0447L ) 425 µl E5V6NEXT (10uM) 425 µl Maxima H- RT Enzyme (Thermo Scientific #EP0753) 50 µl
Set up reagents and plates on BRAVO as follows: If using RNA as input, make sure to normalize concentrations (minimum: 0.5 ng/µl, optimum 20 ng/µl) across samples.

steps.title: Plate cells in 384-well plate
steps.instruction: Plate 2,000–10,000 adherent mammalian cells per well in a Greiner 384‑well clear‑bottom plate; leave unused wells empty (PBS or media only).

steps.title: Select starting material
steps.instruction: If using purified RNA, skip to step 22; otherwise use intact cells and proceed to lysis.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Mix TCL buffer with 1 % β‑mercaptoethanol; prepare enough for all wells (10 µL per 384‑well, 30 µL per 96‑well).

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Aspirate media, wash each well once with PBS using a plate washer; remove most PBS leaving ~10 µL in a 384‑well (≈15–20 µL in a 96‑well).

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL lysis buffer to each 384‑well (30 µL for 96‑well); incubate 15 min at room temperature (0–30 min acceptable); then freeze plate at –80 °C (store up to several weeks).

steps.title: Prepare reagent MARSH plates
steps.instruction: Fill three clean MARSH plates: 40 µL SPRI beads per well, 75 µL 80 % ethanol per well, 35 µL RNase‑free water per well; seal water plate and spin 1 min at 1000 ×g to remove bubbles.

steps.title: Thaw lysate and spin plates
steps.instruction: Thaw lysate plate in the hood for ~5 min; spin lysate plate and water plate 1 min at 1000 ×g before opening seals.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to reaction plate
steps.instruction: Load tips #1; mix lysate thoroughly; transfer 10 µL lysate from each well to a new 384‑well Eppendorf Twintec PCR plate (the “Reaction Plate”).

steps.title: Add SPRI beads and incubate
steps.instruction: Mix SPRI bead source (25 µL 2×); add 28 µL beads to each reaction well (1.5× bead‑to‑sample ratio); mix (15 µL at 5×); incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Bind beads on magnet and wash
steps.instruction: Place reaction plate on magnet (tape down) and incubate 5 min RT; load tips #2; while on magnet, remove liquid to waste; wash beads twice with 25 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s delay before removal each wash); perform a final aspirate to remove all ethanol; dry beads 1 min at RT.

steps.title: Elute RNA from beads
steps.instruction: Load tips #3; add 20 µL nuclease‑free water to beads while still on magnet; remove plate from magnet and resuspend beads (15 µL at 3 mm height, repeat 3×); incubate 2 min RT; place plate back on magnet 5 min RT; transfer supernatant to a fresh 384‑well “Final Plate”.

steps.title: Check RNA concentration
steps.instruction: Select 2–5 random wells; use 2 µL per well for Qubit (target 2–5 ng/µL; 5–10 ng/µL if starting from 96‑well); optionally run RNA Pico BioAnalyzer; RNA may be frozen at –80 °C or used directly for RT.

steps.title: Dispense master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare master mix (components not listed); dispense 36 µL master mix into the first three columns of a new 384‑well Eppendorf Twintec plate (the “Master Mix Plate”).

steps.title: Thaw RNA and adapter plates
steps.instruction: Thaw the RNA plate and the E3V6Next adapter plate (10 µL per well) for 5 min in the hood; spin both plates 1 min at 1000 ×g.

steps.title: Add master mix to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the Bravo, add 4.125 µL master mix to each well of the PCR plate; change tips after every four dispense actions; hand‑dispense any wells that miss volume.

steps.title: Add barcoded adapters
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 10 µM unique E3V6NEXT adapter to each well (adapter plate taped down).

steps.title: Transfer RNA to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the Bravo, transfer 4.875 µL RNA (~5 ng/µL) from the RNA plate (pre‑magnet 1–2 min) to the PCR plate; mix 5 µL three times; ensure residual SPRI beads are not carried over.

steps.title: Incubate RT reaction
steps.instruction: Seal the PCR plate; incubate 1.5 h at 42 °C (air incubator with pre‑equilibrated metal block).

steps.title: Collect cDNA
steps.instruction: Fit the 384‑well PCR plate upside down onto a VBlok collection plate; spin 1000 ×g for 2 min; collect eluate (~3.2–3.6 mL) into a 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Add PB buffer and load column
steps.instruction: Add 5× volume Qiagen PB buffer (≈3.4–3.6 mL) to the Falcon tube; add 10 mL PB directly; rinse the collection plate with remaining buffer and combine; load the entire mixture onto a QIAquick PCR purification column using a vacuum system with a syringe‑barrel “tube extender”.

steps.title: Wash column and dry
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice with 750 µL PE buffer; centrifuge >10,000 ×g for 2 min to dry the column.

steps.title: Elute cDNA
steps.instruction: Add 21 µL nuclease‑free water (pre‑warmed ~60 °C) to the column; let sit 1 min; spin >10,000 ×g for 1 min; collect eluate.

steps.title: Quantify cDNA
steps.instruction: Measure concentration with dsDNA HS Qubit (expected 30–80 ng/µL); do not pause the protocol.

steps.title: Exonuclease I treatment
steps.instruction: Mix 17 µL purified cDNA, 2 µL 10× Exonuclease I buffer, and 1 µL Exonuclease I; incubate as specified in the original protocol.

steps.title: Pre‑amplify cDNA
steps.instruction: Prepare amplification mix (KAPA HiFi 2× ReadyMix optional); run PCR on the 384‑well plate: 95 °C 1 min; 5 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 65 °C 30 s, 68 °C 6 min; 72 °C 10 min; hold 4 °C. (If using KAPA, use 98 °C for denaturation steps.)

steps.title: Dilute PCR product
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL nuclease‑free water to bring each reaction to 100 µL total volume.

steps.title: AMPure XP cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 70 µL Ampure XP beads (1:0.7 ratio) to each reaction; incubate 15 min RT; place on magnet until clear; discard supernatant; wash twice with 500 µL 80 % ethanol; aspirate residual ethanol; air‑dry beads 5 min at RT; elute in 16 µL H₂O; store at –20 °C if needed.

steps.title: Quantify cleaned cDNA
steps.instruction: Use Quant‑iT PicoGreen or dsDNA HS Qubit (1 µL sample); expected 15–60 ng/µL.

steps.title: Dilute cDNA for Nextera
steps.instruction: Prepare 20 µL of 1 ng/µL cDNA; verify concentration with Qubit (5 µL); further dilute to 0.8 ng/µL for Nextera XT tagmentation.

steps.title: Make tagmentation mix
steps.instruction: For each 20 µL reaction combine: 1 µL cDNA (0.8 ng/µL), 10 µL Tagment DNA Buffer, 4 µL H₂O, 5 µL Amplicon Tagment Mix; mix; set up 5 replicates in a PCR strip.

steps.title: Incubate tagmentation
steps.instruction: Incubate reactions at 55 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add NT buffer
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL NT Buffer to each reaction; mix; incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Nextera index mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction combine: 0.5 µL Indexing primer N7XX (5 µM), 0.L µL P5NextPT5 (5 µM), 15 µL NPM PCR Mix, 9 µL H₂O (total 25 µL).

steps.title: Run Nextera index PCR
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL index PCR mix to each tagmented reaction; PCR cycle: 72 °C 3 min; 95 °C 30 s; 12 cycles of 95 °C 10 s, 55 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; final 72 °C 1 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Pool PCR replicates
steps.instruction: Pool all 5 PCR replicates; rinse wells with a total of 50 µL water; combine for ~300 µL pooled library.

steps.title: Cleanup pooled library
steps.instruction: Add 240 µL Ampure XP beads (1:0.8 ratio) to pooled library; incubate 15 min RT; place on magnet, discard supernatant; wash twice with 500 µL 80 % ethanol; aspirate residual ethanol; air‑dry beads 4 min at 37 °C then RT; elute in 15 µL H₂O.

steps.title: Quantify final library
steps.instruction: Measure concentration with dsDNA HS Qubit (expected 1–4 ng/µL ≈4 nM); do not pause the protocol.

steps.title: Assess library size
steps.instruction: Optionally run the library on a Tapestation or Bioanalyzer to assess fragment size.

steps.title: Store library
steps.instruction: Store the final library at –20 °C until sequencing.

steps.title: Final bead handling
steps.instruction: After incubation spin plate 1000 ×g 1 min and remove seal; invert Falcon tube and spin 1000 ×g 1 min; incubate beads 2 min RT; place tube on magnet 2 min, remove 12 µL for final library; use remaining volume on beads for QC; incubate 2 min RT to elute cDNA; place back on magnet, remove 14 µL; use residual beads for Qubit quantification.
